verdict.rationale: A native mobile app is a fair question for a project-management SaaS like Basecamp, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers web features (to-dos, keyboard shortcuts, Hill Charts), the API and the CLI, but never mentions a native mobile app or mobile feature parity with desktop. With no evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality
